auditor_value: A: 2g/7 downward (20/7 ≈ 2.86 m/s² with g = 10; 2.8 m/s² with g = 9.8); B: g/7 upward (10/7 ≈ 1.43 m/s²; 1.4 m/s²); T = 20g/7

findings.quote: twice as small in magnitude, as the constraint requires
findings.note: 'Twice as small' is not literal textbook English; the magnitude of B's acceleration is half that of A's.
findings.fix: aA is positive, so A accelerates downward at 20/7 m/s²; aB is negative, so B accelerates upward at 10/7 m/s², half the magnitude of aA, as the constraint requires.

notes: Answer agrees. The question does not fix g; the solution uses g = 10 (with g = 9.8 the values are 2.8 and 1.4 m/s²). Solving the three printed equations gives aB = −10/7, aA = 20/7, T = 200/7 exactly as printed.
